You are promoted to Fight Camp when your Phase 1 week-5 telemetry clears all five gates. These are the app's own tracked stats — check them on your stats screen after every session. (5) avg_power at or above 55 as a session average on that same final shadowbox day, with round 5 fading no more than 10 points below round 1: the floor proves your mechanics produce real force, the fade cap proves it is conditioned rather than front-loaded — clean-but-slow is not fight-ready.
